# .github/ — GitHub automation and instructions

This directory contains GitHub Copilot repository instructions and the hosted CI
workflows. Current controls mirror the PRIN Session Cycle and Coding Standards
§6; local evidence does not replace required hosted checks.

- `copilot-instructions.md` defines repository authority for Copilot-assisted work.
- `workflows/` contains Rust, Python, parity, GPU, reproducibility, release, Snyk,
  and compensating secret-scanning automation.
